facts.text: Bryn Mawr students can cross-register across the Tri-College Consortium with Haverford and Swarthmore, and take courses at the University of Pennsylvania.

sources.title: Bryn Mawr Consortia
sources.quote: Through the Tri-College and Quaker Consortia, students can seamlessly cross-register at Haverford, Swarthmore, and the University of Pennsylvania.
